name: Cygnus Finance Global USD
oneLiner: cgUSD is Cygnus Finance's rebasing USD stablecoin on Base, backed by short-term U.S. Treasuries and stablecoins, with daily rebases reflecting NAV.
collateral: Short-term U.S. Treasury bills held off-chain, supplemented by on-chain stablecoins (USDC/USDT); supply rebases daily on New York banking days to match portfolio net asset value including accrued interest
pegMechanism: Daily rebase on NYC banking days aligning total supply with portfolio NAV; 1:1 USDC redemption via two-step withdrawal (request + claim, 5–7 day settlement); Transmuter enables instant 1:1 conversion between cgUSD and USDC; Elixir AMO manages on-chain liquidity

mintAuthority.summary: cgUSD is an ERC-4626 rebasing vault on Base where users mint by depositing USDC/USDT (incl. cross-chain via Axelar), but Cygnus custodies the off-chain U.S. Treasury reserves, controls the daily oracle-reported NAV rebase, and runs an AMO managing on-chain liquidity.

controls.label: Cygnus oracle/rebase + reserve custodian
controls.evidence: The cgUSD vault contract exposes an owner-gated oracle-report path (handleOracleReport) that synchronizes total supply to off-chain T-bill NAV on NYC banking days; Cygnus custodies the off-chain Treasuries and authorizes the supply adjustment that user deposits cannot perform alone.

controls.label: cgUSD vault owner (mint/pause admin)
controls.evidence: The Base cgUSD contract is an OpenZeppelin Ownable ERC-4626 vault with a mint() that issues shares for deposited assets and owner-controlled pause/resume; the owner address itself was not independently resolved on-chain.

review.evidence: Cygnus documentation describes user mint with USDC at $1 (0% fee, Axelar cross-chain) backed by off-chain U.S. Treasuries with a daily issuer-controlled NAV rebase and an AMO managing on-chain liquidity; this is a custodian/AMO hybrid rather than a pure issuer fiat mint or a permissionless user-collateralized CDP.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Path corrected from issuer-direct-mint to amo-or-custodian-hybrid: backing is off-chain T-bills custodied by the issuer with oracle-driven rebase and an on-chain AMO, while users mint against on-chain stablecoins. Live owner/oracle admin addresses not independently resolved.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the on-chain owner and oracle-reporter addresses of the Base cgUSD vault, and the AMO controller, before raising confidence.
